output_group.description:
https://boneio.eu/docs/black/configuration/output_group 
 List of grouped outputs to define. Output has to be defined first in output section!

id.markdownDescription:
Group ID

Technical identifier for this group, used in MQTT topics and actions.
id.title: Id

name.markdownDescription:
Display Name

Optional friendly name shown in Home Assistant. If not set, uses id.
name.title: Name

outputs.markdownDescription:
Output IDs

List of output identifiers to include in this group.
Use the effective_id of each output (boneio_output or custom id).
outputs.title: Outputs

all_on_behaviour.description: Behaviour if set true toggle when all outputs are on, otherwise if any is on then group is on.
all_on_behaviour.title: All on behaviour

output_type.description: If HA discovery is used device if relay is light or switch.
output_type.title: Output type

output_group.title: Output group
